status: Design proposals; no gameplay or runtime art changes.

chest.note: Real 3D coffer. The similarly named road pickup is a two-triangle icon card and is excluded.

cultist_altar.note: Compact Chirurgeon slab supplies the base proportions. Cultist reliefs, offering bowl and hostile sigil need new modeling; Guardian architecture is excluded.

tentacles.note: Distributed tendril fragments need reshaping around a compact body; do not import the Guardian node's spacing.

moss.note: Draped growth source; make curio-specific hanging or ground patches instead of importing the full node footprint.

table.note: Direct model export isolates the table from the statically combined inn scene.

dagger.note: Direct model export isolates the knife. Cleavers and hooked blades still need new geometry.

cage.note: Textured cage-chain metal reference; the iron maiden shell still needs bespoke modeling.

web.note: Alpha card; inspect from both sides before runtime use.

cloth.note: Banner fabric and fraying reference; satchels, bindings and curtains require their own mesh and UVs.

gravestone.note: Group source; isolate one marker for a final curio.

shrine.note: Stone carving reference only. Hero Shrine is a chapel, so it is excluded as a statue body.

nurse.note: Cloth/pose reference only for new NPC bodies; do not substitute this nurse unchanged.

designs.title: Wayfarer's coffer
designs.new_work: Split lid, empty interior and shallow bottom tray.
designs.design: Low crooked oak coffer with iron corners, a loose hasp and one readable lid seam.
designs.resolved: Lid tilted back; tray visibly emptied, no persistent reward glow.

designs.title: Ironbound strongbox
designs.new_work: Oversized padlock, lock socket and separate lid.
designs.design: Same traveling coffer family with three iron straps and a large front lock silhouette.
designs.resolved: Lock hangs broken or unlocked; lid rests open.

designs.title: Sealed contract coffer
designs.new_work: Wax contract seal and attached quest pennant.
designs.design: Ironbound coffer with a pale diagonal cloth seal that identifies an objective at corridor scale.
designs.resolved: Seal torn and contents removed; retain empty coffer at its original position.

designs.title: Estate reliquary chest
designs.new_work: Carved lid crest, brass fittings and interior.
designs.design: Broad bowed chest, worn heraldic panel and dark brass corners; avoid a pile of generic loot around it.
designs.resolved: Raised crest lid and empty velvet-lined cavity.

designs.title: Profaned votive altar
designs.new_work: Compact altar cut-down, sacrificial bowl and carved hostile sigil.
designs.design: A low black stone shrine with one tentacle wrapping its base and candles grouped on a single side.
designs.resolved: Bowl clears or candle pattern changes according to resolution; altar remains.

designs.title: Ember votive shrine
designs.new_work: Compact pedestal adaptation and glass votive cup.
designs.design: Pale chipped devotional stone with warm candles, broad front recess and one bright ivory focal point.
designs.resolved: One flame diminishes after use; keep sacred silhouette legible.

designs.title: Water-damaged folios
designs.new_work: Separate loose cover and consumable pages.
designs.design: Three uneven piles of Sprawl books; one open volume faces the player and the spines keep their inked edges.
designs.resolved: Open volume collapses; ash variant is reserved for the existing torch result.

designs.title: Penitent's iron cage
designs.new_work: Bespoke human-shaped iron shell, spikes, hinged doors and interior.
designs.design: Tall tapering torture cabinet with a narrow face opening and heavy outward doors; cage is only a material reference.
designs.resolved: One door opens outward; inner spikes and an empty silhouette remain.

designs.title: Ossuary scatter
designs.new_work: Pickable cluster cleanup and subtle grave dust.
designs.design: Low ribcage fan with three skulls arranged toward the camera, resting on dark earth rather than a black base slab.
designs.resolved: Bones spread apart with a small searched depression.

designs.title: Abandoned travel pack
designs.new_work: Satchel body, leather straps, flap hinge and small buckles.
designs.design: A slumped olive canvas pack with a single long shoulder strap and pale folded cloth at its mouth.
designs.resolved: Flap falls open and strap goes slack; no new items appear before rewards resolve.

designs.title: Roadside flame niche
designs.new_work: Wrought iron wall bracket and portable cropped masonry backing.
designs.design: A black iron torch in a broken stone niche, isolated from the building that originally held it.
designs.resolved: Torch is removed or extinguished according to the current interaction result.

designs.title: Splintered supply crate
designs.new_work: Separate lid slats and interior.
designs.design: A squat crate with uneven pale plank ends, dark nail heads and one lifted corner.
designs.resolved: Top slats displaced; cavity remains dark and empty.

designs.title: Tied provision sack
designs.new_work: Opened neck mesh and a frayed drawstring.
designs.design: Coarse ochre sack gathered at the neck; distinguish it from the leather-strapped travel pack.
designs.resolved: Neck untied and body deflated.

designs.title: Forgotten sentinel
designs.new_work: Bespoke empty armor suit, helmet, shoulder plates and sword.
designs.design: Hollow militia armor on a broken plinth, tilted helmet and one rigid arm resting on a sword.
designs.resolved: Helmet turns slightly or plate shifts; armor remains a stable landmark.

designs.title: Butcher's serving cart
designs.new_work: Wheel/lid separation and small plate details.
designs.design: Narrow Foetor cart with a hanging stained cloth and one recognizable covered platter above the meat.
designs.resolved: Platter opened and scraps reduced; wheels remain still.

designs.title: Ashen memorial urn
designs.new_work: Bespoke lidded urn with handles and painted relief.
designs.design: Large ivory urn on a low chipped step; soot fills carved grooves without hiding the pale silhouette.
designs.resolved: Lid slides off; broken shard variant follows shovel interaction.

designs.title: Burned collector's cabinet
designs.new_work: Glass-front doors, brass lock and replacement display shelves.
designs.design: Tall narrow display case with cracked dark glass, pale shelf edges and a lock at hand height.
designs.resolved: One glass door swings open; shelves empty without changing the cabinet's footprint.

designs.title: Roadside confessional
designs.new_work: Bespoke compact booth, timber lattice and hinged curtain.
designs.design: An angular timber booth in salvaged Sprawl stone, deep red curtain and a small cross-shaped aperture.
designs.resolved: Curtain drawn aside; candle lowers and interior stays dark.

designs.title: Pilgrim's wall fountain
designs.new_work: Separate shallow water basin and water surface.
designs.design: Crop the Oasis arch into a compact devotional fountain; pale central relief and clean water identify its purpose.
designs.resolved: Water level falls a little; faint ripples settle.

designs.title: Scorched archive shelf
designs.new_work: Remove library wall connections and split searchable volumes.
designs.design: One freestanding leaning bookshelf with sparse intact books among blackened shelves.
designs.resolved: A few volumes displaced; shelf silhouette unchanged.

designs.title: Abandoned apothecary bench
designs.new_work: Glass vessels, retort, herb bundles and separable burner.
designs.design: Crooked dark wood bench with three oversized vessels and a broad stained preparation surface.
designs.resolved: Stopper removed or burner spent; optional existing torch outcome uses brief local flame.

designs.title: Bloodied butcher's rack
designs.new_work: Compact rack rebuild and four distinct hooked blades.
designs.design: Foetor frame hung with asymmetrical cleavers; sharp pale edges contrast with rust-red wood.
designs.resolved: One blade shifts and cloth drape drops; searched gaps are visible.

designs.title: Cracked saint's tomb
designs.new_work: Bespoke stone coffin, relief lid and interior.
designs.design: Low angular stone tomb with a carved sleeping face and one chipped corner, not a resized supply chest.
designs.resolved: Lid pushed to one side to expose the empty stone cavity.

designs.title: Bound roadside dead
designs.new_work: Wrapped body adaptation, exposed hand and bindings.
designs.design: Dry desaturated body tightly wrapped against a stump; frayed cloth creates a thin readable outline.
designs.resolved: Bindings loosen and body slumps; stay distinct from edible carcasses.

designs.title: Feasting sacrifice slab
designs.new_work: Stone top substitution and carved channel.
designs.design: Heavy low slab stained dark burgundy with a shallow offering bowl and three uneven steps.
designs.resolved: Offering removed; blood channels remain as paint, without a perpetual glow.

designs.title: Carrion votive cairn
designs.new_work: Compact masonry base and skull sockets.
designs.design: Short altar crowned by a triangular skull stack and two crooked bone uprights.
designs.resolved: Top skull tilts; candle or dust response ends quickly.

designs.title: Defaced barn scripture
designs.new_work: Painted occult glyph panel and loose parchment strips.
designs.design: A broken plaster panel covered by bold charcoal signs, red hand marks and hanging parchment.
designs.resolved: Scratches partially erased or paper torn; keep the same wall fragment.

designs.title: Fermenting farm cask
designs.new_work: Tap, stopper and leaking rim detail.
designs.design: Swollen oak cask on two crude supports; pale tap and a sour green stain suggest dangerous drink.
designs.resolved: Tap hangs open with a short drip; lid or bung remains displaced.

designs.title: Chained funerary tomb
designs.new_work: Stone coffin family plus iron chain, padlock and lid.
designs.design: Same tomb proportions as Sarcophagus, with two broad chain runs and a single large lock.
designs.resolved: Chain loosens beside the opened lid; no silhouette swap to a chest.

designs.title: The abandoned feast
designs.new_work: Bowls, bones, stained cloth and separable dishes.
designs.design: Uneven Foetor table with mismatched bowls and food concentrated at its center.
designs.resolved: Table remains; picked-over dishes and hanging cloth show it has been searched.

designs.title: Sealed heretic scrolls
designs.new_work: Bespoke rolled parchment tubes, wax seals and torn sheets.
designs.design: Three large rolled scrolls and one partially unrolled strip on a rough plank, readable as scrolls rather than books.
designs.resolved: Scrolls unroll or burn according to the existing result; charred ribbons remain.

designs.title: Root-bound wooden coffin
designs.new_work: Bespoke coffin silhouette, separated lid and exposed joints.
designs.design: Long narrow timber coffin pinched by roots, with crooked pale planks and a split headboard.
designs.resolved: Lid leans against the roots; coffin interior stays grounded.

designs.title: Hollow sentinel stump
designs.new_work: Hollow cavity cut, rot lining and removable bark panel.
designs.design: A bent Tangle stump with one broad dark hollow facing the party and a few pale roots at ground level.
designs.resolved: Loose bark falls aside, exposing the searched hollow.

designs.title: Forest carrion
designs.new_work: Bespoke quadruped body, exposed ribs and fur patches.
designs.design: Low boar-like carcass with a visible rib fan and heavy dark hide; meat props supply the native painted material.
designs.resolved: Rib opening widens slightly; scavenged flesh decreases.

designs.title: Hidden woodland spring
designs.new_work: Low round basin and clear water surface.
designs.design: Smaller moss-framed fountain with brighter stone and unbroken water, clearly cleaner than a brackish pool.
designs.resolved: Water ripples and settles; no contaminated color change unless current rules require it.

designs.title: Deserter's canvas shelter
designs.new_work: Open entrance flap and a small searched interior.
designs.design: A compact military tent with frayed ivory canvas, a low pack and an unlit fire ring; reduce large node footprint.
designs.resolved: Front flap pulled aside; pack deflates and fire ring remains cold.

designs.title: Silken road snare
designs.new_work: Bespoke radial web frame, captured bundle and alpha layers.
designs.design: One asymmetrical cobweb stretched between two dead branches, with a dark suspended cocoon.
designs.resolved: Central strands torn and cocoon lowered; retain outer threads as the used state.

designs.title: Mildewed campaign trunk
designs.new_work: Leather trunk corners, straps and separate flap.
designs.design: Flat travel trunk overtaken by damp green growth, with a pale cloth label and one rigid handle.
designs.resolved: Straps loosen and lid opens; moisture remains a painted detail.

designs.title: Hastily covered burial
designs.new_work: Small soil mound, shovel notch and opened grave depression.
designs.design: A low uneven earth mound marked by a broken stick or short stone, with one exposed bone.
designs.resolved: Soil pushed into two side heaps, exposing the shallow pit.

designs.title: The bound watcher
designs.new_work: Bespoke branch cross-frame, knots and cloth skull wrap.
designs.design: A narrow crooked wooden figure bound in faded red cloth, one skull facing the player.
designs.resolved: Bindings unravel slightly and head slumps; avoid turning it into a friendly hero shrine.

designs.title: Drowned cargo chest
designs.new_work: Barnacle clusters, seaweed fringe and split lid.
designs.design: Salt-white encrusted coffer on a dark wet timber base, with growth concentrated along the lid seam.
designs.resolved: Barnacles break away and lid opens; shells remain around the footline.

designs.title: The poisoned shallows
designs.new_work: Shallow rock bowl, water shader surface and foam fringe.
designs.design: A broad low pool edged by black Shroud rocks; sour olive water contrasts with clean springs.
designs.resolved: Surface disturbed with a small reduced pool; no reward cue before outcome resolution.

designs.title: Drowned congregation idol
designs.new_work: Isolate central shrine figure, compact pedestal and barnacles.
designs.design: A squat fish-faced devotional stone with two candle niches and a cool salt-stained rim.
designs.resolved: Candles extinguish or offerings vanish; stone silhouette remains.

designs.title: The armored pearl shell
designs.new_work: Bespoke ribbed two-part oyster shell, nacre interior and pearl.
designs.design: A broad scalloped shell with a heavy black underside and one ivory inner lip; shrine textures provide marine stone reference only.
designs.resolved: Upper shell hinges back to reveal an empty nacre hollow after collection.

designs.title: Leviathan's castoff
designs.new_work: Split belly and searchable body cavity.
designs.design: Large native Shroud fish laid diagonally on wet planks, jaw and pale ribs facing the party.
designs.resolved: Belly opens and loose flesh shifts; head and tail stay in place.

designs.title: Broken prow saint
designs.new_work: Bespoke carved female figurehead and splintered prow beam.
designs.design: Tall weathered wooden figure with flowing carved cloth, wedged into a short broken ship prow.
designs.resolved: One hanging ribbon falls; the wreck fragment remains recognizable.

designs.title: The whispering reef
designs.new_work: Bespoke branching coral mesh and pale crust texture paint.
designs.design: An upward coral fan in muted ivory and cold mauve, with thick irregular branches and deep black gaps.
designs.resolved: One small branch snaps or polyps retract; silhouette remains a coral fan.

designs.title: The first abandoned camp
designs.new_work: Tent family with a simpler entrance and stronger value contrast.
designs.design: Same shelter language as Traveller's Tent, cleared of foreground clutter so the first interaction reads immediately.
designs.resolved: Entrance opened and pack searched; tutorial identity remains separate in data.

designs.title: The highwayman's bait
designs.new_work: Visible sprung wire, nail trap and independent lid.
designs.design: Small inviting coffer with a deliberately visible thin wire and a torn bandit ribbon; avoid hiding the warning in clutter.
designs.resolved: Wire slack and lid open after the existing trap or safe interaction resolves.

designs.title: The starless invitation
designs.new_work: Bespoke compact Shambler altar profile, torch socket and sigil.
designs.design: A steep black altar with a large central torch socket and restrained red tendrils; combine Chirurgeon stone with Guardian tendril materials.

designs.title: Sunken covenant panel
designs.new_work: Bespoke fish/cult relief panel and chipped stone frame.
designs.design: Low wide carved marine relief propped against a broken wall, with shallow cold highlights and thick dark grooves.
designs.resolved: A small fragment breaks loose; relief remains at the same anchor.

designs.title: The concealed coffer
designs.new_work: Nested compartment, jeweled key plate and interior.
designs.design: Very small ornate coffer tucked beneath a folded drape, clearly more deliberate than an ordinary supply box.
designs.resolved: Inner compartment opened and jewels removed.

designs.title: The ancestor's field bag
designs.new_work: Bespoke leather bag, family clasp and map roll.
designs.design: A heavy dark leather knapsack with a pale heraldic clasp, tightly rolled map and worn red lining.
designs.resolved: Map unrolled and flap opened; clasp persists as the landmark.

designs.title: First road supplies: shovel
designs.new_work: Chest family and a clearly visible shovel bundle.
designs.design: Keep the ordinary open-coffer silhouette, with a pale shovel handle and blade visible at the top.

designs.title: First road supplies: key
designs.new_work: Pack family plus a clearly visible key ring.

designs.resolved: Key ring and contents removed; flap rests open.

designs.title: First road supplies: holy water
designs.new_work: Sack family plus three pale glass bottles.
designs.design: Tied provision sack with a small bright bottle rack at its mouth; bottles supply the first-reading cue.
designs.resolved: Bottle rack emptied and neck untied.

designs.title: First road supplies: food
designs.new_work: Pack family plus wrapped bread and dried food.
designs.design: Slumped travel pack with one pale food bundle and an open corner, visually distinct from the key pack.
designs.resolved: Bundle removed and fabric relaxes.

designs.title: The impossible gift
designs.new_work: Ordinary coffer family plus an original restrained cloth gift seal.
designs.design: Keep the base unlocked chest silhouette and its separate identity; add a small pale knot as a readable gift cue.

designs.title: The violated burial
designs.new_work: Deep open soil cavity and broken coffin lining.

designs.resolved: Fresh earth pushed aside; searched cavity remains visible.

designs.title: Raider's abandoned satchel

designs.resolved: Torn flap falls open and loose contents vanish.

designs.title: Pilgrim's relic case
designs.new_work: Small shrine-shaped case, holy seal and removable relic tray.
designs.design: Compact peaked reliquary with ivory carved sides, a brass front grille and one clear objective seal.
designs.resolved: Grille open and tray empty; quest identity stays distinct from a normal heirloom chest.

designs.title: Field surgeon's medicine case
designs.new_work: Medical bag, brass clasps and capped vials.
designs.design: Low leather medical satchel with a pale cross-tag and three large bottle silhouettes.
designs.resolved: Case opened with empty vial slots; avoid implying a new healing interaction.

designs.title: Sealed grain delivery
designs.new_work: Grain label stencil and separate sack mouths.
designs.design: Two low shipment crates under tied grain sacks; one pale wheat mark reads as the objective cue.
designs.resolved: Crate opened and grain bundle removed.

designs.title: The missing cargo
designs.new_work: Three-crate arrangement, rope seals and objective pennant.

designs.resolved: Front crate opened and seals broken; group footprint unchanged.

designs.title: Infected votive stone
designs.new_work: Compact altar family with corruption sockets and removable tendrils.
designs.design: Familiar devotional altar partly swallowed by dark growth; one clean stone face remains for recognition.
designs.resolved: Corruption recedes locally after the existing cleansing action; keep the altar mesh.

designs.title: The plague carrier
designs.new_work: Disease sacs, sheet flap and treatment-state variant.
designs.design: Human body under a stained field sheet, one hand exposed and dark swollen growth kept low on the silhouette.
designs.resolved: Sheet pulled aside and infestation depleted after cleansing; no standing NPC replacement.

designs.title: The hunting covenant
designs.new_work: Antler crown, compact branch stand and carved offering bowl.
designs.design: A Foetor timber shrine crowned by a large antler arc and bound skull, with an obvious low offering bowl.
designs.resolved: Bowl cleared and bindings relax after the existing ritual.

designs.title: The warding obelisk
designs.new_work: Bespoke short obelisk, carved sockets and activated rune layer.
designs.design: A compact chipped ivory obelisk with three large dark runes and one sealed recess for the quest action.
designs.resolved: Runes remain faintly lit after activation; persistent objective state controls the art.

designs.title: The last signal
designs.new_work: Tall beacon cage, brazier and flame socket.
designs.design: A narrow tapering stone beacon with a large sheltered brazier at the top; bright point is limited to the flame.
designs.resolved: Brazier lit only after the existing objective activates it.

designs.title: The fractured threshold
designs.new_work: Bespoke incomplete stone ring, ground plate and portal surface.
designs.design: Broken standing ring on a low engraved base, with a dark central aperture and pale fractured rim.
designs.resolved: Brief distortion during existing travel; stable dormant state afterwards.

designs.title: The blood-fed hive
designs.new_work: Hanging hive shell, slit entrance and insect silhouettes.
designs.design: An elongated papery hive suspended beneath a dead branch, native Courtier eggs clustered at its root.
designs.resolved: Shell splits and swarm thins; retain an empty torn casing.

designs.title: The crimson spring
designs.new_work: Basin adaptation, blood-water surface and gilded crest.
designs.design: Courtly fountain with black stone, faded gold rim and dark crimson water; eggs invade only the lower cracks.
designs.resolved: Water level drops and egg film breaks after use.

designs.title: The court's remains
designs.new_work: Elongated vampire skull accents and powdered-wig scraps.
designs.design: A pale bony scatter with two long jaw shapes and scraps of court finery, distinct from ordinary human bones.
designs.resolved: Searched bones spread; finery becomes flatter and dirtier.

designs.title: Pulsing blood eggs
designs.new_work: Individual shell separation and ruptured variant.
designs.design: Use the native DD2 Courtier egg shapes in a low readable cluster, with red veins and a dark moist base.
designs.resolved: Several shells split and collapse; remaining eggs stop pulsing.

designs.title: The hooded supplicant
designs.new_work: Bespoke seated Blood Shrew body, hood, hand and animation rig.
designs.design: A small hunched court survivor beneath a ragged deep-red hood, one open hand extended; nurse is cloth reference only.
designs.resolved: Hand lowers and figure hunches back after the existing encounter.

designs.title: The elder supplicant
designs.new_work: Bespoke elderly Blood Shrew body, exposed head and cane.
designs.design: Unhooded bent elder on a low stool, pale elongated face and rigid cane; keep distinct from the hooded variant.
designs.resolved: Cane settles and body becomes still; preserve NPC identity.

designs.title: The court's cruel amusement
designs.new_work: Bespoke striker tower, bell, mallet and score board.
designs.design: Tall warped fairground strength tester in faded court colors, large mallet at its foot and a small bell above.
designs.resolved: Striker rests high or low according to the existing result; no result telegraph on hover.

designs.title: The drinking bloom
designs.new_work: Bespoke bloodflower stem, broad petals and tubular mouth.
designs.design: One large dark-red fleshy bloom rising from pale native egg growth, framed by sparse black leaves.
designs.resolved: Petals close and stem bows after use.

designs.title: The ruined reception
designs.new_work: Silver platter forms, stained lace and courtly cart rails.
designs.design: Narrow banquet cart with tarnished pale platters and a wine-dark lace cloth; keep the food silhouette above the rail.
designs.resolved: Platters opened and picked over; cloth hangs lower.

designs.title: Cellar master's last bottles
designs.new_work: Bottle cluster, straw lining and broken-bottle state.
designs.design: Open-sided wine crate with three oversized black-green bottles, pale neck labels and a torn crest ribbon.
designs.resolved: Bottles removed or broken; loose straw exposed.

designs.title: Crimson gate-key coffer
designs.new_work: Red key-shaped clasp and a matching large ribbon.
designs.design: Small Court coffer marked with a red ribbon and an unmistakable key-shaped front plate.
designs.resolved: Key compartment emptied; red ribbon remains for used-state recognition.

designs.title: Azure gate-key coffer
designs.new_work: Blue key-shaped clasp and two-notch heraldic plate.
designs.design: Same keyed coffer family, with a blue cloth strip and a two-notch metal plate so color is not the only cue.
designs.resolved: Compartment emptied; blue strip and two-notch plate remain.

designs.title: Verdant gate-key coffer
designs.new_work: Green key-shaped clasp and leaf-cut heraldic plate.
designs.design: Same keyed coffer family, with a green ribbon and leaf-cut plate to distinguish its identity.
designs.resolved: Compartment emptied; ribbon and leaf plate remain.

designs.title: Saffron gate-key coffer
designs.new_work: Yellow key-shaped clasp and sun-cut heraldic plate.
designs.design: Same keyed coffer family, with a yellow ribbon and sun-cut plate that stays readable in low light.
designs.resolved: Compartment emptied; sun plate remains without a reward glow.

designs.title: The court jeweler's case
designs.new_work: Narrow jewelry drawers, velvet lining and separate lid.
designs.design: Ornate low court case with thin pale fittings and burgundy velvet visible through its lid seam.
designs.resolved: Open lid reveals empty individual jewelry recesses.

designs.title: The blood court treasury
designs.new_work: Gilded crest and egg-overgrown lock adaptation.
designs.design: Broad estate chest invaded by native Courtier eggs along one hinge, with restrained tarnished gold corners.
designs.resolved: Lid opens and eggs split at the hinge; treasury is visibly emptied.

designs.title: The spreading clutch
designs.new_work: Root attachments and a more dispersed ruptured variant.
designs.design: A flatter native egg cluster crawling across an ordinary regional stump; preserve infestation identity outside the Court.

designs.title: The Miller's provision armoire
designs.new_work: Farm armoire doors, shelves and crystalline cracks.
designs.design: Tall crooked farmhouse cupboard with pale chipped paint and cyan-violet crystal seams held to one corner.
designs.resolved: Doors open and shelves empty; crystal seams stay dormant.

designs.title: The harvest provision chest
designs.new_work: Farm chest lid and crystalline hinge detail.
designs.design: Low farm chest with diagonal timber braces and a small shard trapped beneath the hinge.
designs.resolved: Lid open and contents removed; preserve the armoire/chest distinction.

designs.title: One life, preserved
designs.new_work: Single small life crystal and shallow stone cup.
designs.design: One warm pale crystal held in a low stone cup; a solitary vessel distinguishes single-hero health restoration.

designs.title: One mind, released
designs.new_work: Small polished memory crystal and open folio.

designs.title: The fractured harvest

designs.title: The broken hour marker
designs.new_work: Bespoke leaning crystal monolith and fractured ground socket.
designs.design: Tall asymmetrical blue-violet standing stone, one great crack crossing its face and a compact farm-stone base.
designs.resolved: Crack briefly brightens during transition, then returns to a stable dormant state.

designs.title: The forgotten vintage
designs.new_work: Ancient tap and rotten support beams.
designs.design: A darker narrower cask than Moonshine Barrel, framed by dead ivy and a faded cellar label.
designs.resolved: Tap slack and bung removed; age remains readable in the wood.

designs.title: The forbidden reading stand
designs.new_work: Bespoke slanted lectern and chained oversized tome.
designs.design: A steep black stone reading stand holding one pale open book, with a single heavy chain crossing its spine.
designs.resolved: Book shut or chain loosened; lectern remains fixed.

designs.title: Unassigned salvage coffer
designs.new_work: Ordinary chest family only; no new gameplay identity assigned.
designs.design: Neutral unadorned coffer reserved for legacy art references until a live encounter needs it.
designs.resolved: Use the ordinary emptied chest state.

designs.title: The mildew-bound volume
designs.new_work: Oversized tome cover, loose pages and fungal spine.
designs.design: One broad swollen book on a low fallen plank, pale pages trapped beneath a moss-green cover.
designs.resolved: Cover opens and a few pages scatter; no new rules implied.

designs.title: The faceless remnant
designs.new_work: Bespoke faceless statue head, folded hands and compact plinth.
designs.design: Tall eroded cult figure with folded hands and a blank face, wrapped by one low root-like tendril.
designs.resolved: Dust falls from the face; no permanent glow added.

designs.title: The roadside forgotten
designs.new_work: Decayed body adaptation, torn clothing and exposed rib patch.
designs.design: A low human corpse in torn road clothes, earth and moss around the feet; keep separate from the infected quest corpse.
designs.resolved: Cloth pulled aside and searched body settles into the earth.

designs.title: A remnant of the old world
designs.new_work: Preserve the owner's DD1-style curio art; optional DD2 stone frame only.
designs.design: Keep the existing DD1 spectral silhouette. A restrained DD2 broken-stone frame may ground it in the corridor without replacing its identity.
designs.resolved: Fade the spectral remnant only when the existing memory state resolves; never change its encounter or rewards.
